## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install nbskill in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure nbskill package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to nbskill
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/MorsCerta-crypto/nbskill):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/MorsCerta-crypto/nbskill.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/MorsCerta-crypto/nbskill)

``` sh
$ conda install -c MorsCerta-crypto nbskill
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nbskill/)

``` sh
$ pip install nbskill
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/MorsCerta-crypto/nbskill)’s
[pages](https://MorsCerta-crypto.github.io/nbskill/). Additionally you
can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/MorsCerta-crypto/nbskill) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nbskill/) respectively.
